ask: can u make a countdown for the drop and list who's buying for who
sentence: Counts down to a ticket sale start time, shows which buyer gets tickets for which people, tracks each buyer's result, and tracks a payment owed between two people.
use_when: A group is waiting for a ticket sale and wants a shared countdown
Two people will buy tickets on behalf of the rest and everyone needs to see who buys for whom
Buyers need to mark whether they got tickets or failed, with a backup plan
One person owes another money for a ticket and the group wants to track if it was paid
dont_use_when: Splitting many shared expenses among a group
Voting on which event or date to pick
Scheduling a meeting or event time across people's calendars
